exposure: Dual use of opium and tobacco
outcome: Risk of small for gestational age
Risk of small head circumference at birth
cohort: 1840 pregnant women (920 exposed to opium during pregnancy and 920 unexposed) in the rural area of the Golestan province, Iran
finding: Maternal opium use during pregnancy was associated with increased risks of giving birth to a small for gestational age infant, as well as a term infant with short birth length or small head circumference.
